summary: Comprehensive e2e testing of TMAIT (Traffic Management AI Tool). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passing (auth for all 3 roles, register+lowercase-email handling, jobs CRUD, role permissions, KB indexed docs, reviewer edit-plan/approve/reject, PDF export, feedback logging). Frontend: full Playwright suite passing for client, reviewer, and admin — login → dashboard → sidebar → request form → plan document (5 signage rows, 12 setup steps, 5 TMM citations) → Leaflet map (9 markers) → KB modal (3 docs / 289 chunks) → Edit Plan flow (persisted) → PDF download (10139 bytes, valid %PDF- header) → logout. Role-based UI visibility verified (client cannot see KB / Edit / Approve / Reject). AI generation was NOT re-triggered (verified by main agent; existing pre-generated job 67c7cffc reused per instructions).

minor.issue: role validation is silently coerced (admin -> client) instead of returning 400/422 — acceptable but could be more explicit for API consumers
Only updates admin password_hash on mismatch, but does not update reviewer/client passwords if they change in code — minor since seed values are stable

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:135 GET /api/jobs excludes 'plan' and 'sources' fields from list — good for perf; ensure this stays consistent when Dashboard adds new filters
auth.py:12 bcrypt.hashpw().decode('utf-8') — hash format $2b$ confirmed via login flow; correct
server.py:158 client-owned check compares job.client_id to user.id — clean; ObjectId excluded via projection ({"_id": 0}) everywhere ✓
Dashboard.js:51 uses timeout: 300000 (5min) for /generate — matches 60-180s LLM generation time; good

AuthContext.js stores token in localStorage AND server sets httpOnly cookie — dual mechanism (Bearer via interceptor + cookie fallback in auth.py) works, but localStorage token is XSS-visible; consider cookie-only in future
RequestForm.js requires only title+location; other fields have sensible defaults — good UX
KnowledgeBase.js polls /api/kb/docs every 5s while modal open — could hit backend unnecessarily; minor
server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' — FastAPI/Starlette will warn/reject '*' + credentials in newer versions; consider explicit origins for prod
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed jobs via pytest (client, admin) and via Playwright (admin). All safe to purge; visible in reviewer/admin sidebar. The pre-generated job 67c7cffc-aee6-4b1a-8e0a-272f786f0b8b is now in 'approved' status (approved by pytest test_reviewer_approve_creates_feedback). Reviewer feedback entry logged. To re-test approve/reject UI flow on this job, main agent would need to reset its status to 'pending_review' or generate a fresh plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and UI flows verified working with real data. LLM generation flow was NOT re-executed (per instructions — main agent already verified with 5 citations, 9 markers, 8 RAG sources). The pre-generated job (67c7cffc-aee6-4b1a-8e0a-272f786f0b8b) is now in 'approved' status — if you need to re-test approve/reject buttons visibility, either reset the job status in Mongo (db.jobs.update {status:'pending_review'}) or trigger a fresh generation on a new job. PDF export tested end-to-end: valid PDF bytes, 10KB+. Leaflet map + KB modal both functional. No blocked or unverified integrations remain — OpenAI/Anthropic keys work per pre-generation evidence, Nominatim geocoding verified (Vancouver coordinates present in map markers).
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found. Only test-scaffolding issues in my own tests (email-case assertion) which I fixed.
